snippet.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Makiatto [Rhapsody Quartet] Preview Video
snippet.description:
Commanders, the brand-new Elite Doll Makiatto, her Elite Weapon [Bittersweet Caramel], and her exclusive Outfit [Ballroom Interlude] will be released on December 26! 

At the same time, the fully voiced, limited-time Themed Event [Rhapsody Quartet] will also be available!

Get ready for a variety of new gameplay features and limited-time events. Don't miss out!
